Strategy: Crowding-conditioned narrow awkward-band avoidance. Exact fits score highest; when at least ten bins are open, residuals between half the item and the full item lose half the item, while tighter and roomier residuals rank like Best Fit; otherwise rank like Best Fit. The choice differs from Best Fit when many bins are open and the tightest fit falls in that narrow band. It may help by avoiding awkward leftovers when alternatives exist, but may fail if alternatives are rare.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else (-(r - item) - item / 2 if len(bins) >= 10 and r - item > item / 2 and r - item <= item else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Crowding-conditioned narrow awkward-band: penalize (item/2, item] by item/2 only when >=10 bins open.
